visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with short, neat black hair, wearing a white graphic T-shirt featuring a stylized robot character, stands in a brightly lit indoor living room. He looks directly at the camera, speaking with animated facial expressions, squinting eyes, and active hand gestures to emphasize his points about his son's growth. (2) The man and a teenage boy with wavy black hair stand back-to-back in a narrow, brightly lit white hallway. The boy is visibly taller, reaching past the man's head. They turn slightly toward each other to acknowledge their height difference with surprised and satisfied expressions, while the camera captures their side profiles. (3) Close-up shots display a height measurement chart mounted on a white wall and a paper medical report showing a growth curve graph with specific data points. The man reappears in his kitchen, gesturing with his hands against a background of blurred domestic items and warm indoor lighting. (4) The camera focuses on a refrigerator and a storage shelf stocked with numerous small white and green cartons of milk. The man picks up a single carton and holds it close to the lens, clearly displaying the 鮮乳坊 brand name and a cow illustration on the packaging. (5) The teenage boy stands outdoors in soft daylight, drinking milk through a straw. A white sports backpack with green Tai Tzu Ying text is shown, with a milk carton being placed into its open compartment. The man returns to the screen, showing two fingers for a v sign while smiling warmly. (6) A short 2D animation depicts a stylized green farm with black-and-white cows and buildings with solar panels. Inside the house, the man shows various refrigerated products, including white buns in a bamboo steamer and yogurt containers with colorful labels, before pointing to a QR code at the end.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged male voice speaks with a friendly, energetic, and high-arousal tone, exhibiting clear articulation and a moderate speech rate. Upbeat, mid-tempo acoustic pop background music featuring acoustic guitar strumming and a steady, light drum beat begins immediately, establishing a positive and informative atmosphere for the vlog content. (2) The narrator's pitch remains stable and conversational as he describes the medical visit and growth statistics. The BGM remains at a consistent, balanced volume level without drowning out the speech. The recording environment sounds studio-clean with no significant ambient noise or room reverb, indicating a controlled indoor setting. (3) A soft digital whoosh transition sound effect triggers a shift in topic toward sleep and nutrition. The speaker's delivery becomes more structured, with deliberate pauses used for emphasis. The music continues with a cheerful melody in a major mode, maintaining the video's high-energy and encouraging mood throughout. (4) The speaker's voice becomes more enthusiastic and assertive when describing the benefits of the milk product. A crisp, incidental sound of a straw being used to drink liquid is heard clearly over the BGM. The acoustic guitar and drums continue their rhythmic pattern, perfectly synchronized with the fast-paced editing style. (5) As the narrator discusses pricing and group buy details, his tone shifts to a professional promotional delivery with high dominance. The BGM tempo remains steady around 115 BPM. A faint metallic click of a refrigerator door closing is audible in the background, adding a layer of domestic realism to the track. (6) The final phase features a clear call to action with the narrator encouraging viewers to join the group buy. His voice maintains a high positive valence and clarity. The BGM gradually fades out over the last few seconds, ending in studio silence as the contact information is displayed on the screen.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Personal Hook -> Educational Evidence -> Product Solution -> Pricing & CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a group buy for '鮮乳坊' (Fresh Milk House) milk products by sharing the creator's personal experience with his son's growth progress. It combines lifestyle vlogging with educational tips on child growth (sleep and nutrition) to establish trust before introducing the product's benefits and an exclusive discounted price.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator directly presents the product, mentions a 'group buy' price, provides a discount, and includes a QR code for purchase.
